content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in finding out the maximum number of outputs that can be connected to a [product_name] when using all possible expansion modules. My goal is to connect 36 outputs, but I'm unsure if this is achievable with a [product_name]. Thank you.

You can determine the maximum capability of the [product_name] without referencing the manual; check the information in the provided image. Achieving 36 outputs from a single [product_name] is not possible. However, you could potentially network several base units or utilize Modbus/TCP for networked outputs. It is advised to investigate which network output solutions suit your requirements and budget. I recommend considering a PLC instead of the [product_name] programmable relay for higher output needs.

Hello [user_name], The maximum for a single [product_name] is: 24 digital inputs, 8 analog inputs, 20 digital outputs, and 8 analog outputs. This is the maximum configuration with expansion modules. It is possible to connect with other [product_name] units for extended capabilities: Maximum [product_name] network setup.
With just one [product_name], it's not possible. Each [product_name] can access up to 20 digital outputs. By networking a second [product_name], you could reach 40 digital outputs.
Thank you all for your answers! I will continue researching further.
